Full suite is green. 

The change is contained to a single file. `AuditOwnerCreated.service` now builds the same `OwnerDto` the responder produces (mapper + `HouseholdTier.applyGold`, so the logged `membershipLevel` matches the response exactly even with the household bump) and adds `membershipLevel` and `membershipNumber` to the audit line while keeping the existing `id`, `customerCode`, and `registrationDate` fields. Only one function changed, its cyclomatic complexity stays at 1, and no other class was touched.

The audit line now reads, e.g.:
```
owner created id=11 customerCode=NSW-16E6609E registrationDate=2026-09-02 membershipLevel=2 membershipNumber=NSW-16E6609E-M26
```
